text:
Rachel (AE): Hey team — need a concise POC provisioning checklist + handoff for AcmeHealth. They want hosted API keys first, then dedicated pool if throughput >200 req/s, and VPC peering for PHI. Timeline: 2 weeks. Can we confirm owners?

Omar (SE): Can we reuse existing POC workspace (aws-staging-2)? Sales needs a checklist with commands and an estimated cost number to close.

Tess Eng: Draft below — please copy to the POC template and add owners.

Tess Eng: 1) Hosted API key (short-lived, scoped)
- Console: API Keys > New key, scopes: generation, embeddings
- Set expiry 14d, restrict to origin regex, label: poc/acmehealth
- cURL example (admin token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
 -d '{"label":"poc/acmehealth","scopes":["generation","embeddings"],"expiry":"2026-04-05T00:00:00Z"}'
```

Tess Eng: 2) Dedicated pool (only if required)
- Console: Dedicated > Request capacity. Pick GPU type by target latency (g4dn.xlarge for low-cost, A100 for high throughput)
- Autoscale: min=1 max=3, fallback: hosted route
- Include expected RPS and p99 latency target in request ticket

Tess Eng: 3) Private / VPC (for PHI)
- Raise VPC peering ticket with: customer CIDR, aws-account-id, desired route table, contact IP allowlist
- Security items: KMS key ARN if customer-managed, retention policy, access logging requirements

Omar (SE): Can you paste the ticket template?

Tess Eng: Support ticket template:
Subject: POC Dedicated/VPC request — AcmeHealth
Body:
- Customer: AcmeHealth
- Environment: POC (14d)
- Need Dedicated? yes/no -> if yes, size: (gpu_type), throughput target: 250 req/s
- VPC peering details: customer CIDR, customer ASN (if using VPN/transit), preferred region
- KMS: Provide key ARN if customer-managed
- Attach: signed DPA (if PHI), security questionnaire, contact person
- Approvers: Kevin Platform, CM Security

Tess Eng: Cost notes for AE (rough):
- Hosted: low barrier, usage-based — ballpark $0.02 /k tokens for this estimate (confirm with pricing sheet)
- Dedicated: baseline daily cost + per-GPU increment (see internal pricing sheet)
- Add network egress and VPC peering fees to estimate
- Link: https://sheet.redwood/poc-pricing

Kevin Platform: I'll own Dedicated provisioning. Assign to me after AE confirms requirements.

CM Security: For PHI -> require SOC2, executed BAA, KMS in customer account preferred, logs forwarded to customer SIEM if requested. No token-level logs persisted for PHI workloads. Need completed questionnaire before VPC setup.

Rachel (AE): I'll get DPA and security questionnaire signed. Proposed timeline: kickoff Mon 2026-04-06, hosted keys by Wed, dedicated pool by next Wed if approved.

Omar (SE): I'll run smoke tests and share a short checklist:
- connectivity: curl /health with key
- generation smoke: 5 sample prompts, p99 under target
- embeddings: 10 vectors, cosine sanity check
- logging: confirm no PII in logs
- perf: run vegeta script (attached) to validate throughput

infra-bot: Ticket #12345 created for VPC peering (assigned to Kevin Platform). ETA 48h.

Rachel (AE): Perfect. I'll update the POC handoff doc in Confluence and ping Legal for the DPA.

Tess Eng: I'll convert this thread into /doc-templates/poc-handoff.md and include a short runbook with the cURLs + smoke test scripts.

Kevin Platform: Noted. Tagging @tess_eng for follow-up and I'll block time for provisioning.

Rachel (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup:
